o.text: Morphologically gəzmək (“to walk”) + -dir. Cognate with Turkish gezdirmek (“to walk”)

From Proto-Turkic *sïč- (“to defecate”).
Cognate with Turkish sıçmak, Chuvash сыс (sys, “to defecate”), etc.
By surface analysis, izafet II compound of ipək (“silk”) + qurd (“worm”).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish اورو (örü), from Proto-Turkic *ȫrü, ultimately a derivation from Proto-Turkic *ȫr- (“to rise”).
